derivation.method: The r2 public draft was not rewritten. Course-owner decisions were recorded in a new r3 artifact and then encoded as a new rubric, prompt, and skill snapshot. V5.2 results informed calibration topics only; they are not V5.3 performance results.

before_private_gold: Review and merge the public r3 rubric, prompt, scoring-gate validator, and tests.
Obtain separate explicit authorization for a new private development-only gold revision.
before_packet: Freeze the merged r3 skill, prompt, rubric, and authorized private development gold as one contract.
Validate the execution-contract rubric, scoring-gate behavior, and deduction-trace output schema.
Reuse the previously validated T1 transcript source only after binding it to a new G1 packet.
before_model_run: Obtain a new explicit development-only run authorization.
Run G1-Codex and official DeepSeek V4 Flash against the same newly frozen G1 packet.
Do not rerun T1, access heldout material, or infer V5.3 results from V5.2 outputs.
before_public_report: Publish only privacy-audited aggregate metrics and disagreement categories.
Do not publish traces, student identifiers, answers, transcripts, gold rows, raw model responses, or private locations.

limitations.en: This is a human-calibrated V5.3-r3 development candidate and static-validation record, not a private gold revision, prompt packet, model run, metric, or production claim.
limitations.zh: 这是经课程负责人校准的 V5.3-r3 开发候选及静态验证记录，不是私有 gold 修订、prompt packet、模型运行、指标或生产能力声明。

next_action.en: After public review and a separate authorization, create a new private development-only gold revision and one matched G1 packet for Codex and DeepSeek V4 Flash. Do not access heldout material.
next_action.zh: 公开审查通过并获得单独授权后，才可创建新的私有开发集 gold 修订，以及供 Codex 与 DeepSeek V4 Flash 共用的一份 G1 packet；不得访问留出集。
